new_value.scope: Populate the required public Alternatives column with already authorized non-primary complete candidates. All39 complete reading/reason fields remain unchanged; no added candidate, changed primary, new image, changed hand scope or count.
new_value.common_scope: Each alternative retains the same literal contour and component hand/role/attachment scopes as its full reading. Semantic-state text selects no additional ink. Complete multi-letter, word, formula and deletion-state candidates are preserved. The existing public reading/final fields continue to print every candidate.
new_value.empty_list_scope: An empty list remains only where the row records a mark/role/hand or single-reading qualification without an enumerated non-primary complete candidate in the root decision. No alternative is invented for that column.
